    SELECT XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM races
    WHERE XCL_069 = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
      AND XCL_066 = 2021
),
fin AS (
    SELECT res.XCL_075 AS driver_id,
           d.XCL_040 AS birth,
           CAST(res.XCL_089 AS REAL) AS speed
    FROM results res
    JOIN race r ON res.XCL_074 = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    WHERE res.XCL_077 IS NOT NULL
),
youngest AS (
    SELECT driver_id, speed
    FROM fin
    ORDER BY birth ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT CAST((h.speed - y.speed) AS REAL) * 100 / h.speed
FROM (SELECT speed FROM fin WHERE driver_id = 1) h
CROSS JOIN youngest y
